info.name: Secure Office
info.summary: Forensic Watermarking, DLP, and ENS Compliance for Nextcloud Office
info.description:
Nextcloud Secure Office is an enterprise security extension designed for environments requiring high-assurance data protection, forensic traceability, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) across collaborative office documents in Nextcloud Office (Collabora Online / CODE).
Key Features: - Dynamic Forensic Watermarking: Injects real-time indelible background watermarks displaying user identity, client IP, access timestamp, and classification tags. - Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Prevents unauthorized document exfiltration by disabling export/downloads (DisableExport), clipboard copy/paste (DisableCopy), and document printing (DisablePrint). - Storage Encryption Compatibility (ENS [mp.info.3]): Full compatibility with Nextcloud Server-Side Encryption (SSE) with Master Key mode (AES-256-CTR). - Immutable Audit Trail (ENS [mp.info.2]): Logs every document access to a dedicated database audit table with direct CSV export. - Continuous Compliance Engine & CLI: Features a diagnostic dashboard in Administration Settings and terminal auditor (occ secure_office:ens-audit).
Specifically architected to assist public administrations and regulated entities with the Spanish Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS - Real Decreto 311/2022).
info.author: Norberto Martín Afonso
